entry.recoveryOnlyIfFirstReturnsFalse: one explicit blocking compacting GC.Collect(MaxGeneration, Aggressive, true, true), then one reservation attempt
entry.guestInvocationsPerRequest: zero if both reservations fail; exactly one if reserved
entry.existingRegion: reject; never collect/end a region already owned by another caller
entry.collections: one explicit recovery request is not a promise of one actual runtime collection; record deltas
entry.failure: same typed gc-* infrastructure failure; no silent restart or unprotected fallback

measurement.roundTripMs: includes entry and transport; never subtract GC cost
measurement.realGameProgress: entry delay postpones only this player's returned action; no common barrier or compensation
measurement.algorithmGcDeltas: must remain zero inside a completed protected call
measurement.heapSnapshots: estimated current managed bytes plus latest-GC heap/fragmented/committed/available bytes; not current OS RSS
